Tech Spec
Got it! Let’s go in depth:

ProjectSkillBridge – Full Technical Specification

1. Goal & Problem Statement
Developers often want to break out of their comfort zones, expanding their tech stack while also aligning with job market demands. ProjectSkillBridge will analyze a developer’s GitHub repos, match their skills against target job postings, and recommend specific projects to bridge skill gaps. It’s a personal, local tool that guides devs toward showcasing and developing relevant tech skills.

2. Key Features
	•	GitHub Integration: Connect to a user’s GitHub (via API or token). Analyze repos for languages, frameworks, and project patterns.
	•	Job Input: Allow users to paste in job descriptions or link to postings. Extract key requirements (e.g., Go, Rust, cloud tech, etc.).
	•	AI Matching: Use an AI model (like your Claude API) to compare user skills with job requirements. Identify gaps.
	•	Project Recommendations: Based on the gap analysis, generate 2–3 suggested project ideas that would help demonstrate those skills (e.g., build a small Go API, a Rust CLI tool, deploy something to AWS).
	•	User Control & Storage: Let users save recommended projects locally if they want to revisit them. Simple local cache—no large DB needed.
	•	Project Templates: Offer some predefined templates or GitHub links to help users start faster.

3. Tech Stack & Architecture
	•	Language: If you want to step into Go or Rust, this is a perfect project to use one of them. Choose Go or Rust for the core backend logic.
